sourceNotes: 清理优化支持切换 Mole 引擎，提供安装入口、独立预览、执行确认与可取消的实时日志
原生优化页新增重置缩略图与 Spotlight 搜索修复入口，复用现有系统维护能力
端口、进程与应用服务支持相互定位，可从连接查看所属进程和应用
清理页面按应用缓存、开发者等分类展示，两列卡片自然展开，隐藏不支持清理或没有安装与缓存记录的项目
应用卸载预览分阶段展示候选并在后台统计大小，保留用户勾选，未完成扫描前不开放清理
更新应用与 README 图标，统一闪电标识
取消普通目录扫描的固定时间与条目限制，按当前负载调整并发，并修复取消及退出时的扫描工作进程回收
修复 Homebrew 自定义缓存和保留项保护，避免通用缓存清理误纳入工具管理的目录
修复连续切换音频输出时的取消竞态，以及部分虚拟输出设备采样率不同导致的音频不可用问题
修复部分分块网络响应被截断后仍当作完整内容解析的问题

en: Add a Mole engine for cleanup and optimization, with an installation entry, independent previews, execution confirmation, and cancellable live logs. Mole follows its own rules; native selections and protected items do not apply to Mole.
Add thumbnail reset and Spotlight search repair entries to native optimization, using existing system maintenance capabilities.
Link ports, processes, and app management so connections can lead to their owning process and app.
Group cleanup by application caches, developer tools, and other categories, let two-column cards size to their content, and hide unsupported items or apps with no installation or cache records.
Show uninstall candidates in stages and calculate sizes in the background while preserving selections; cleanup remains unavailable until scanning finishes.
Update the app and README icons with a consistent lightning-bolt design.
Remove fixed duration and entry limits from ordinary directory scans, adapt concurrency to current load, and fix scan-worker reaping on cancellation and app exit.
Fix protection for custom Homebrew caches and preserved items so generic cache cleanup does not include tool-managed directories.
Fix cancellation races during repeated audio-output switches and audio failures on virtual outputs with different sample rates.
Fix truncated chunked network responses being parsed as complete content.
